detaileddescription.para: This file contains the definitions for axi timer implementation. MODIFICATION HISTORY:

para.preformatted: Ver Who Date Changes ----- ---- -------- ------------------------------------------------------- 1.0 adk 24/11/21 Initial release. adk 07/02/22 Updated the IntrHandler as per XTimer_SetHandler() API. 1.1 adk 08/08/22 Added doxygen tags. 2.4 vmt 08/20/26 Added weak sleep and tick timer instance variables. 2.5 vmt 09/24/26 Initialize the AXI tick timer from SetIntrHandler when IsReady is not set so the handler can be installed before the tick interval is programmed. 2.5 vmt 09/24/26 Added AXI timer tick configuration from frequency. 2.5 ml 09/22/26 Fixed doxygen 1.15.0 and compliance checker warnings.
